name: boxd
description: A Letterboxd lens with no API key. Reads a member's public RSS diary, a film's JSON-LD block and the poster wall through one throttled, cached fetcher, then does the arithmetic Letterboxd doesn't: a taste profile (mean, median, histogram, like and rewatch rates, decades) and an overlap between two members — shared films, an agreement score, the hardest disagreements, and what each has loved that the other hasn't logged. Letterboxd 403s a chatty client within seconds, so requests are spaced, pages are cached to disk, a block is reported as a block rather than as an empty result, and the stale cache answers when the live page won't.

endpoints./info: Null call — what this module is and what it exposes
endpoints./health: Liveness — no network call, so it answers while Letterboxd is blocking
endpoints./sources: The three public surfaces this reads, and how sturdy each one is
endpoints./diary: A member's feed, newest first (user, limit, kind=watch|review|list|all, fresh)
endpoints./reviews: Only the entries they wrote something about (user, limit, fresh)
endpoints./member: Who this is, plus the headline numbers off their diary (user, fresh)
endpoints./taste: How they rate — mean, median, histogram, likes, rewatches, decades (user, fresh)
endpoints./overlap: Two members against each other — agreement, splits, what to steal (a, b, fresh)
endpoints./film: One film by slug or title — cast, crew, genres, runtime, site rating (title, year)
endpoints./films: The poster wall — everything a member has logged, newest first (user, fresh)

sources.rss: letterboxd.com/{member}/rss/ — the diary, with rating, liked, rewatch and watched-date as real fields. The spine: it answers under load.
sources.film: letterboxd.com/film/{slug}/ — one film out of its schema.org JSON-LD block, cached a day
sources.grid: letterboxd.com/{member}/films/ — the poster wall, ~72 per page. Throttled first; the diary answers when this does not.

notes.no_key: Letterboxd's own API has been invite-only beta for years — there is no key to apply for, and nothing here uses one
notes.throttle: 1.4s between requests fleet-wide, plus a disk cache under ~/.mod/boxd/cache
notes.coverage: the RSS feed is a window of roughly the last 50 logged films, not a lifetime — every derived number says so in its own coverage field
notes.closed: search and the global charts are 403 from this box, so boxd has no search; pass a username or a film slug
